Fixed. Added support for Jakarta nullity annotations:

- **`src/core/lombok/core/configuration/NullAnnotationLibrary.java`**: registered a new `JAKARTA` library (`jakarta` → `jakarta.annotation.Nonnull` / `jakarta.annotation.Nullable`), so `lombok.addNullAnnotations = jakarta` works, including in `CUSTOM:` configs.
- **`src/core/lombok/core/handlers/HandlerUtil.java`**: added `jakarta.annotation.Nonnull` to `NONNULL_ANNOTATIONS` (enables null checks) and `jakarta.annotation.CheckForNull`/`Nonnull`/`Nullable` to `BASE_COPYABLE_ANNOTATIONS`, so these are copied to generated setters, builders, with-ers, etc. — fixing the reported `@Builder` case.

Validation: `ant test.instance` — the `NullLibrary3` (jakarta) test now passes; the 4 remaining failures (`*OnRecord*` tests) were confirmed pre-existing on the unmodified tree.
